name: vibemoji-monorepo
description: Top-level scripts for building and running vibemoji's core (web) and desktop shells.

scripts.desktop-build: npm --prefix core run build && npm --prefix desktop run build:win
scripts.desktop-run: npm run web-build && npm --prefix desktop run sync-core && npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.install-all: npm --prefix core install && npm --prefix desktop install
